holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved standalone net profit of ₹14,843 crore and consolidated net profit of ₹16,333 crore for Q2 FY2027.
The bank announced a revision of select cash transaction charges on savings accounts effective December 1, 2026.
The bank's CASA ratio declined by 340 basis points to 36.1% amid an increase in FCNR (B) deposits.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 7.07% makes ICICI Bank the largest single position in the fund. Its 3-month return of -2.52% softens returns across the 29.7% financial sector allocation.

watch.text: Implementation of revised savings account cash transaction charges starting December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank initiated an internal investigation into two senior executives regarding the alleged leak of sensitive business secrets.
Kaizad Bharucha will step down as Deputy Managing Director on December 31, 2026, while Lily Vadera was reappointed as independent director.
Quarterly net profit reached ₹21,537 crore on revenue of ₹95,132 crore for the quarter ended September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.84% weight, HDFC Bank was the fund's largest detractor over 3 months with a -7.12% return and an estimated -0.416% contribution.

watch.text: Findings from the internal probe into confidential data leakage by senior executives.
Executive transition following Kaizad Bharucha's planned departure on December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Rahul Shukla was appointed as Group Head for Commercial and Bharat Banking starting October 19, 2026.
Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached ₹7,666 crore, rising 38% year-on-year.
The bank's stock dropped over 4% after quarterly profit fell short of market expectations.

expected.text: Axis Bank's loan growth forecast was raised to 20% for FY27 and maintained at 15% for FY28.

seeing.text: Quarterly earnings fell short of expectations, causing the stock to decline over 4% despite a 38% year-on-year profit gain.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank is the third-largest bank holding at 3.91%. It posted a -0.9% 3-month return, reinforcing the fund's heavy 29.7% exposure to private banking.

watch.text: Progress in Commercial and Bharat Banking under newly appointed head Rahul Shukla.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: The proposed IPO of subsidiary Jio Platforms Limited opened with a dedicated reservation for eligible RIL shareholders and reached full subscription within 100 minutes.
ICRA reaffirmed RIL's AAA/Stable rating on non-convertible debentures and assigned AAA/Stable to ₹50,000 crore of bank facilities.
Moody's noted that the Jio IPO will boost RIL's financial flexibility and help lower debt servicing costs.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.39% portfolio weight, Reliance is the fund's primary energy holding. It detracted an estimated -0.234% over 3 months following a -6.89% return.

watch.text: Completion and listing of the Jio Platforms IPO and subsequent debt reduction impact.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T secured large construction orders for New Delhi Secretariat buildings and two office towers in Amaravati.
The company received a limited notice to proceed for the New Tashkent airport and began pre-construction work on October 19, 2026.
The Indian Navy commissioned the Samarthak, a major naval warship built by L&T.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 2.64% of the fund and is its key infrastructure asset within a 14.8% Industrials allocation. It declined -4.06% over 3 months.

watch.text: Q2 FY2026 financial results consideration by the board on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: M&M's equity stake in NDET decreased from 72.07% to 49.63%, resulting in NDET ceasing to be a step-down subsidiary.
The company transferred shares from its Employees' Stock Option Trust to grantees following option exercises.
Subsidiary Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services reported a 55% jump in Q2 net profit to ₹882 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.36% of the portfolio, M&M was among the top bottom contributors over 3 months, detracting an estimated -0.267% after a -11.32% return.

watch.text: Operational developments following the dilution of NDET below subsidiary status.

holdings.name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd

what_changed.text: The company scheduled a board meeting for November 5, 2026, to approve unaudited Q2 and half-year FY2026 financial results.
Ontario authorities approved the dissolution of inactive indirect subsidiary Yachiyo Canada on October 14, 2026.
The New York State Workers' Compensation Board levied a USD 19,500 penalty on subsidiary Motherson Technology Services USA.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.28% in the portfolio, Motherson delivered a 6.23% 3-month return, generating +0.142% in estimated contribution to lead the consumer discretionary basket.

watch.text: Quarterly earnings results release and analyst conference call on November 5, 2026.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved Q2 FY2027 results featuring a 54% YoY increase in B2C Net Order Value and 76% growth in adjusted revenue to ₹24,621 crore.
The board approved an internal restructuring of the Going-out India business and a share swap of Adonmo for ₹156 crore worth of Mygate shares.
Flipkart initiated pilot testing of a competing food-delivery service named 'Eat-in by Minutes' in Bengaluru.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.21% weight, Zomato added +0.133% estimated contribution over 3 months with a 6.04% gain, offsetting drags from older cyclical holdings.

watch.text: Completion of the Adonmo stake swap for Mygate shares valued at approximately ₹156 crore.
Competitive fallout from Flipkart's food-delivery tests in Bengaluru.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI reported an unauthorized dark-web data breach affecting 3,897 customer records, confirmed on October 16, 2026.
The bank confirmed that customer account balances remain completely safe despite the cyber incident.

holdings.why_it_matters: SBI makes up 1.99% of the portfolio. Its -4.21% 3-month return mirrors the weakness across the fund's 29.7% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Follow-up regulatory disclosures regarding dark-web cyber exposure of customer data.

holdings.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiary KIME completed the 100% acquisition of KTSPL for ₹8.25 crore on October 1, 2026.
The company incorporated Kirloskar International B.V. as a wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands on October 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.98% weight, KOEL detracted an estimated -0.281% over 3 months as its share price dropped -14.19%.

watch.text: Operational progress and business activities under newly incorporated Kirloskar International B.V.

portfolio.statement: Financials and industrial cyclicals drove a 3-month fund decline of -4.83%, while selective tech holdings provided modest positive support.
interp: Heavy allocation to banking (29.7%) created systematic downside as HDFC Bank, SBI, and Axis Bank all declined over the 3-month window.
Growth in technology and auto component holdings such as Zomato and Samvardhana Motherson partially countered weakness in core capital goods and energy.
portfolio.line: A high concentration in mega-cap banking and heavy industrial manufacturing dictated recent fund drag.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank contributed -0.416% to 3-month fund returns following a -7.12% drop.
Kirloskar Oil Engines detracted an estimated -0.281% over 3 months after falling -14.19%.
Mahindra & Mahindra returned -11.32% over 3 months, detracting an estimated -0.267%.
Zomato added +0.133% in estimated contribution over 3 months, posting a 6.04% gain.

themes.title: Private Banking Dominance
themes.text: A combined weight of over 16% in ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, and Axis Bank ties fund performance tightly to credit growth, deposit costs, and banking governance.

themes.title: Industrial and Infrastructure Execution
themes.text: Substantial capital allocated to civil infrastructure, defense shipbuilding, and engineering equipment exposes the fund to order book momentum and project execution.

macro.factor: Banking deposit competition and CASA compression
macro.why: Deposit mix shifts toward term and foreign currency deposits compress low-cost CASA ratios across large private lenders.
Public and private infrastructure contracts, as well as defense procurement, drive revenue conversion for construction and engineering suppliers.

priced_in.text: Strong capital demand and investor appetite for the Jio Platforms IPO.
CASA ratio compression and margin pressure in private banking.

could_change.title: Findings from HDFC Bank's Internal Information Leak Investigation
could_change.text: Conclusions from the ongoing executive probe could influence governance perception and management stability.

could_change.title: Expansion of Quick-Commerce and Food Delivery Competitors
could_change.text: New entrants like Flipkart testing food delivery could challenge platform market share and unit economics for consumer tech positions.

portfolio.risk_note: With Financials accounting for 29.7% of fund assets and 99% overall equity share, performance remains vulnerable to adverse banking sector developments and asset quality trends.
